questions.question_bn: Charges +Q at x=0, −2Q at x=30 m। between charges potential zero point-এর x কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Potential scalar: kQ/x−2kQ/(3×(10)−x)=0⇒3×(10)−x=2x⇒x=(10)। electric field সেখানে zero নয়।

questions.question_bn: Thin lens powers +8 D ও −2 D in contact। equivalent focal length কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। In-contact lens powers add: P=(8)−2 D। f=1/P metres; f values সরাসরি যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: Twoidenticalcellsε=5 V,r2ΩparallelwithloadR 1Ω। load current কত A?

questions.question_bn: Particle velocity first(27,36),then(27,−36)m/s,transition 2s; average acceleration magnitude কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Δv=(0,−8×(9)), elapsed 2s⇒aavg=(0,−4×(9)),magnitude 4×(9)। speed unchanged কিন্তু vector velocity বদলেছে।

questions.question_bn: Thickness 3μm slab index 1.5 একটি Young slit সামনে। added optical path কত μm?

questions.question_bn: Air1m³-এ pollutant gas 11 cm³, sameT,P। volume ppm কত?

questions.question_bn: Stock 5M। first 10fold,then 5folddilution। final molarity কত?

questions.question_bn: l=13 subshell-এ magnetic quantum number mₗ কতটি value নিতে পারে?

questions.question_bn: HCl1.0×10⁻²M-কে 4 গুণ volume dilute। water ionisation negligible। pH কত?

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 16L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।

questions.question_bn: Diluted water initial DO8mg/L, after 5days 6mg/L; sample fraction 1/25, blank correction 0। BOD₅ কত mg/L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। DO depletion=2mg/L in diluted mixture। Original sample BOD=(DOinitial−DOfinal)/fraction=2nmg/L।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 16%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44

questions.question_bn: MX₂(s)⇌M²⁺+2X⁻। pure-water molar solubility s=9×10⁻⁴M। Ksp কত?

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 210g,dry mass 168g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(21)/(10×(21))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।

questions.question_bn: Ore60g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?

questions.question_bn: A⇌B-এর K=20। 2B⇌2A-এর equilibrium constant কত?

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((9)×10⁻²)=(1/(9))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻12M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(12)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: Bleach sample 17 mol OCl⁻ acidic iodometry-তে I₂ কত mol মুক্ত করে? OCl⁻+2I⁻+2H⁺→I₂+Cl⁻+H₂O
